free_tier.stated: No published per-user quota and no quota endpoint; storage is GPX-only and appended to the OSM rails DB + a trace store. Effectively unlimited in count, tiny per unit.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: free, no auth for public traces; individual points also exposed via the API 0.6 trace endpoints

interface_detail: Web form + `POST /api/0.6/gpx/create` (401 Unauthorized without auth. Verified).
tooling: any GPS app with OSM upload; `gpx_files` API; bulk via the rails API
chaining: Not a blob store. .gpx (+ .zip/.tar.gz bundles) only. Useful as an append-only time-series archive, not for arbitrary objects.
limits_note: GPX only (zip/tar/tar.gz accepted as a bundle). Visibility model changed in Aug 2026: 'Public' and 'Private' deprecated, leaving 'Identifiable' and 'Trackable'. Trackable = not listed publicly but still retrievable by id.

identity_cost.detail: Email. Verified the live form: fields are `user[display_name]`, `user[email]`, `user[pass_crypt]`, `user[pass_crypt_confirmation]`. Email confirm, no affiliation, no review.

reliability_note: Format-locked and ODbL-licensed; a trace is public-by-default unless you pick Trackable, so it is a poor fit for anything non-geographic.
confidence_note: reported: the pages read on 2026-11-03 are three OpenStreetMap wiki pages. https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Upload states that only GPX traces can be uploaded, several in one zip, tar or tar.gz file. https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/API_v0.6 states that the GPX upload call requires authentication and that since August 2026 an upload must give the visibility trackable or identifiable (public and private now return an error). https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Visibility_of_GPS_traces states that Public and Private were deprecated in August 2026 and that points are available via the API for every visibility level. These are community wiki pages, not a vendor quota page. The absence of a per-user quota, the sign-up form and the API authentication-failure answer are not covered by those pages, and the clause that a Trackable trace is retrievable by id is not stated on those pages, so the rung stays reported.
